summary: Today’s live feed is risk-off for crypto and risk-off to neutral for equities, with analysts leaning bearish on BTC and gold while a few FX commentators are still constructive on USD/CAD. The strongest fresh downside calls in the available sources are Mike McGlone’s bearish BTC view and daily gold technicals showing a strong downtrend, while Solana is flagged as weak below prior support.
